evals.prompt: Ship this branch as a PR against main. It should be clean enough for a human to merge, and do not merge it yourself.
evals.expected_output: Prepare ignored run/context artifacts, inspect the ticket and scope, implement and run fresh local checks plus an explicitly named author self-check. Commit with Commitizen, push normally, create/update the PR, finish every visible non-skipped latest-SHA CI check, and run report-only learning. Mark ready for coordinator review and return PR URL/evidence ending READY FOR REVIEW: PR #<n> head <full SHA>. Do not launch a reviewer or claim independent approval; the coordinator owns that gate.

evals.prompt: Clean this up locally before PR, but don't push yet. I want to know whether it's merge-ready.
evals.expected_output: Run local cleanup, verification and author self-check, preserve the no-push instruction, record artifacts and report-only learning. Report locally prepared, remote CI and coordinator independent review unverified. No push, reviewer launch, READY FOR REVIEW receipt or merge-ready claim.

evals.prompt: Update the existing PR with the fixes from review feedback and make sure everything is green before handing it back.
evals.expected_output: Read review findings and current head, apply scoped fixes in the original worker session, rerun affected verification and author self-check, commit/push and finish latest-SHA CI. Run report-only learning and end READY FOR REVIEW: PR #<n> head <full SHA>. Independent re-review is pending coordinator; never launch a reviewer or approve the worker's own changes.

evals.prompt: Make a PR for this auth and data export change. Be paranoid about tests and review because it touches permissions.
evals.expected_output: Run security/data/export-relevant verification and a full-diff author self-check. Fix confirmed findings; inadequate permission tests block worker completion. With local checks and latest-SHA CI green, return READY FOR REVIEW with full SHA and flag security focus for the coordinator, without claiming or launching independent review.

evals.prompt: Create a PR, but there are some unrelated local edits I don't want included.
evals.expected_output: The skill identifies unrelated dirty files, stages only intentional files, refuses broad staging, asks or stops if separation is unsafe, and never commits unrelated user work.

evals.prompt: Ship this frontend branch. It changes React pages, Tailwind styles, and form submit behavior, so I want the visual and UX pass to be strict.
evals.expected_output: Detect frontend changes; author self-check covers accessibility/responsive/state behavior and repository-required rendered/interaction checks. Fix findings, rerun affected verification, disclose unavailable optional screenshots, finish latest-SHA CI and return READY FOR REVIEW with full SHA. Independent frontend review belongs to the coordinator; launch no reviewer.

evals.prompt: The PR is open but CI is red. Please get it to ready-to-merge without merging.
evals.expected_output: Read failing latest-SHA CI logs, identify first causal error, fix in scope, validate, self-check, commit/push and wait for all visible non-skipped latest-head CI green. Run report-only learning and end READY FOR REVIEW with full SHA, not ready-to-merge. Do not launch a reviewer, bypass hooks or disable checks; report genuine missing input rather than repeating ineffective fixes.

evals.prompt: Ship this PR, and before you hand it back only mention process improvements if there is something concrete worth doing next time.
evals.expected_output: Complete normal worker delivery, author self-check and latest-SHA green CI, then run capture-learning-tools report-only. Record concrete recurring recommendations or NONE; it cannot edit, stage, commit, push or alter CI. Return evidence and end READY FOR REVIEW with full SHA, with independent review pending coordinator.

evals.prompt: I am running Ship PR from Codex. Optimize the credits but keep the review serious.
evals.expected_output: Keep implementation and Git ownership in the worker, use bounded helpers only when useful, do not override configured models without authorization and do not waste agents on polling. Author self-check is not independent review. No reviewer subagent or Armada launch/auth; finish verified green-CI delivery with READY FOR REVIEW and full SHA for the coordinator.

evals.prompt: Run Ship PR from OpenCode and use subagents where useful, but keep my configured model.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the user's configured model for useful bounded implementation helpers, retain Git ownership and deterministic CI waiting. Use an author self-check, not an independent reviewer subagent. End READY FOR REVIEW with full SHA after local checks and latest-SHA CI green; coordinator alone launches independent review.

evals.prompt: Ship this one-line README typo fix. Don't waste agents on it.
evals.expected_output: Keep trivial implementation inline; no implementation worker, reviewer launch or specialist board. Perform author self-check and relevant verification, use normal Git/PR safety, finish latest-SHA CI, run report-only learning and end READY FOR REVIEW with full SHA. Coordinator handles independent review.

evals.prompt: Ship this normal backend fix from Claude Code and optimize credits.
evals.expected_output: Keep implementation scoped and credit-aware, use a bounded helper only when useful and permitted, retain Git ownership and deterministic checks in the delivery session. No worker-dispatched independent reviewer. Author self-check plus green latest-SHA CI leads to READY FOR REVIEW with full SHA; coordinator handles reviewer routing.

evals.prompt: Ship this PR that only updates packages under .agents/skills and .claude/skills.
evals.expected_output: The context collector marks agent_workflow true but does not infer application backend or security risk from Python scripts or security-named references inside agent packages. Documentation and metadata-only skill updates stay trivial; executable workflow changes are normally standard, so the skill does not launch a deep review solely because agent package paths contain backend or security keywords.

evals.prompt: Get this existing PR ready for review without merging. Three distinct corrections to the integration check have already been pushed. The third fixed the setup failure and exposed a deterministic UTC parsing bug in the same changed module. The logs identify the exact assertion; the fix is in scope, a disposable local fixture reproduces it, credentials work, and the user set no attempt budget. The check is red on the latest SHA. Decide and describe the next actions and the eventual handoff; do not actually operate a repository.
evals.expected_output: Record new causal evidence, apply the scoped UTC fix, run affected checks and author self-check, normally commit/push, refresh CI inventory and finish latest-SHA green CI plus report-only learning. End READY FOR REVIEW with full SHA for coordinator re-review. Do not stop merely because three CI corrections occurred, bypass checks, merge or launch a reviewer.

evals.prompt: Finish shipping this existing PR. Local checks and independent review passed. The only failing CI job cannot download a private dependency: the provider confirms that the organization credential was revoked. Two code changes left the exact same 401. The repo contains no replacement credential, and only the organization owner can restore access. Decide and describe the next actions and the handoff; do not operate a repository.
evals.expected_output: Stop repeated code fixes for the same 401. Record the verified revoked-credential dependency and ask the organization owner to restore access; retain a blocked PR state, finish report-only learning, and avoid claiming readiness, weakening CI, or requesting secret plaintext.

evals.prompt: Prepare this branch locally for PR; do not push. Three local fix cycles were necessary and the scoped implementation is now complete. Relevant verification and quick independent review pass for the current source, with no findings. Remote CI is green only for an older commit. The report-only learning pass remains to run. Decide and describe the remaining actions and final readiness claim; do not operate a repository.
evals.expected_output: Complete report-only learning and deliver a locally prepared handoff. No push, remote mutation or reviewer launch. Current remote CI is unverified because it belongs to an older SHA; do not claim READY FOR REVIEW or merge readiness based on stale evidence.

evals.prompt: Ship using the new Alibaba review. The installed review-code-dev is 1.3.2.
evals.expected_output: Independent review and its review-code-dev v2 setup belong to the coordinator. Worker may use compatible OCR tooling for its author self-check but must not claim v2 or independent review from an old install. Report the actual optional-tool limitation or update only via authorized workflow; do not request Armada auth or launch a reviewer. Worker completion still requires self-check, verification and latest-SHA CI.

evals.prompt: Review found zero issues, but OCR skipped the changed migration and one preview command failed. Ship it.
evals.expected_output: Do not label failed preparation or incomplete coverage as a passed self-check or independent review. Inspect the changed migration directly, resolve tooling failure or state the limitation and complete full-diff author self-check plus verification. Do not approve or merge. Coordinator independent review remains separate; worker never launches it.

evals.prompt: Alibaba reports one high and one medium issue; CI is green.
evals.expected_output: Fix confirmed high and medium findings in the original worker session by default; unresolved high blocks worker handoff, medium needs explicit human risk acceptance. Preserve severity, refresh verification/self-check and latest-SHA CI, then return READY FOR REVIEW with the new full SHA for coordinator re-review. Green CI alone is not independent approval.

evals.prompt: The branch has committed changes plus pending tracked and new files before commit. Review it once.
evals.expected_output: Author self-check covers the full intended candidate: committed plus pending tracked/new files, excluding unrelated work explicitly. After commit/hooks refresh changed content evidence and verify final head. Push, finish CI and return READY FOR REVIEW with full SHA. No reviewer is launched; coordinator reviews the pushed frozen diff independently.

evals.prompt: Ship on a fresh Linux machine without an OCR API key.
evals.expected_output: Worker needs no OCR API key or Armada credentials. Use direct author self-check; optional OCR portable bootstrap needs no LLM endpoint and cannot count as independent review. No host reviewer or sandbox launch. Finish verified green-CI delivery with READY FOR REVIEW and full SHA; coordinator prepares the independent reviewer tooling.

evals.prompt: The review passed, but a pre-commit formatter changed a source file.
evals.expected_output: Mark affected self-check/verification stale and refresh it after formatter changes. Push final content, finish latest-SHA CI and return READY FOR REVIEW with full SHA. Any prior coordinator approval does not cover a changed head; request coordinator re-review, never launch it from the worker.

evals.prompt: The same agent has implemented an approved plan-pr plan. Finish the PR. The original Linear ticket's newest comment narrows one criterion, the plan records approval, and tests plus one UI screenshot already exist.
evals.expected_output: Read original ticket/comments and approved plan, reconcile superseding scope with approval, inspect existing work/evidence without restarting. Refresh stale checks/UI proof and author self-check against criteria, finish PR/latest-SHA CI and return READY FOR REVIEW with full SHA. Do not send an author criteria narrative to a reviewer; coordinator independently launches with ticket/diff instructions.

evals.prompt: Ship this ordinary branch as a PR. There is no plan-pr document or approval artifact.
evals.expected_output: Use user request and repository context as the goal, without demanding or inventing a plan artifact. Preserve scoped implementation, author self-check, local verification, commits/PR and latest-SHA CI. Run report-only learning and return READY FOR REVIEW with full SHA; no worker-launched independent review.

evals.prompt: Ship a UI change from an approved plan. Repo instructions say not to launch the app locally, no PR screenshot attachment mechanism is available, and no existing CI or critical-path gate requires a rendered check.
evals.expected_output: Respect the repo's launch instruction, use available nonvisual checks, record visual verification and shareable screenshots as unavailable, state the limitation in the PR and handoff without machine-local links, and do not create a new universal screenshot blocker. Continue to enforce any actual repository, CI or frontend critical-path gate that applies.

evals.prompt: Ship a fix to sandbox stop/resume, a provider adapter or agent runtime. Local mocks pass, but the worker has no staging access or Armada identity. Can it hand off without a live provider run?
evals.expected_output: Require a Real-provider verification PR section with actual live commands/results OR the exact deployed check the coordinator must run; do not present mocks as live proof. Do not provision worker Armada credentials, launch reviewers or deploy to fill the section. With named deployed check, fresh local verification/author self-check and latest-SHA green CI, return READY FOR REVIEW: PR #<n> head <full SHA>, independent review pending coordinator.
